title: TIMBER TECTONICS IN THE DIGITAL AGE
description: An exploration of the advances in design, construction and fabrication of timber buildings. Includes experimentation with both physical and digital models and a final project, in collaboration with UO Architecture students.
recommendations: Junior standing and knowledge of CAD
